description: Compile one look from the style library into the exact settings to send in ONE update_theme_settings call (palette, fonts, shape, spacing and a signature custom_css on the stable [data-lk] hooks), plus the menu section style to set, the photo to put in the home hero (hero_image, if any), how to shape the home page, the copy voice, and do / don't lists. By default it uses the logo's color when the logo has a strong one. level: safe, distinct or bold (from suggest_styles, or the owner's ask: 'bolder' / 'simpler').

seed_color.description: Lead color to build the palette from, e.g. the owner's brand color
